name: Librarian
description: A person at the library's desk who registers members, adds tools to the catalog, records each return with the tool's condition, and reports damage and repairs.

name: Member
description: A registered neighbor who borrows available tools from the catalog, up to 3 at a time, and brings each back by its due date.

name: Owner
description: The person who runs the library and answers for its business outcomes: each month they check how far the library has come toward them.
